Everyday sizes

How to measure your foot and find your shoe size at home

By the Metre team · Updated 26 Oct 2026 · 2 min read

Short answer

Stand on a sheet of paper with your heel against a wall, mark the tip of the longest toe, and measure from the wall to the mark. Do both feet in the evening and use the longer one. Convert the length to a size with the brand's chart, because sizes differ between brands. Between two sizes, choose the larger.

What you need

  • A sheet of paper, a pen and a ruler or tape
  • A wall and a flat floor
  • The evening, when feet are largest

Step by step

  1. Set up

    Tape a sheet of paper to a hard floor with one edge against a wall. Wear the socks you usually wear with the shoes.

  2. Stand on the paper

    Stand with your heel against the wall and your weight evenly on both feet.

  3. Mark the longest toe

    Mark the tip of the longest toe. It is not always the big toe.

  4. Measure the length

    Measure from the wall to the mark in millimetres. Repeat for the other foot.

  5. Convert with the brand's chart

    Use the longer foot and the size chart of the brand you are buying. If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one.

Why the evening

Feet swell during the day, so measuring in the evening avoids buying shoes that are tight by the afternoon.

Do it with Metre

Shoe size Pro

  1. Open Shoe size and stand on a sheet of paper with your heel against a wall.
  2. Measure from the wall to the tip of the longest toe with the tape tool, or with the camera.
  3. Metre converts the length to EU, UK and US sizes.

Measure both feet in the evening and use the longer one. Shoe size is part of Metre Pro.

iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later. Get Metre on the App Store.

How accurate is this?

A foot length measured with a phone is an estimate, and brands cut shoes differently. Treat the converted size as a starting point and check the brand's own chart and return policy.

Measurements made with a phone are estimates. Before you cut, order or build, confirm critical dimensions with a physical tape.

Questions people ask

How do I measure my foot length?

Stand with your heel against a wall on a sheet of paper, mark the longest toe and measure from the wall to the mark.

What if I am between two sizes?

Choose the larger size, especially for closed shoes.

Why do sizes differ between brands?

Each brand uses its own lasts and charts. Always check the maker's size guide.
